messages:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up everyone 1 - our medical/dental benefits vendor is switching to ZenithCare effective 2026-05-01. This requires a short acknowledgement and, if you cover a domestic partner, an updated enrollment doc. Please complete the e-sign ack + enroll changes by end of day Tue. Also: mandatory 12-min HIPAA microtraining for anyone who touches PHI (payroll, HR, ops). :white_check_mark:
Tom (HRBP): Thanks Rae. Will current coverage lapse during the transition?
Rae (People Ops): No gap 1 - claims will continue to process during the switch. New policy documents and SBCs are on the benefits hub. Enrollment window for changes/additions: 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-30.
Lina (Manager): For domestic partner enrollments, what proof is required? Do you have a template?
Rae (People Ops): Acceptable docs: joint lease, joint bank stmt (last 3 months), or domestic partner affidavit signed and notarized. I'll attach an example affidavit to the hub. For bulk uploads use the CSV template below.
Rae (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,domestic_partner_flag,domestic_partner_doc,beneficiary_update_needed,preferred_enroll_slot```
Ava (SWE): Quick Q: are part-time employees eligible immediately or after waiting period?
Tom (HRBP): Part-time employees who average >= 20 hours/week are eligible from the vendor transition date. New hires should be in the CSV with "start_date" to confirm eligibility mapping.
Ava (SWE): Contractors? Need to know for one contractor who gets gym discount via benefits.
Tom (HRBP): Contractors do not get medical/dental unless on an extended contract and enrolled on the company plan. Gym and perks handled separately; benefits-bot will annotate per-user eligibility.
benefits-bot: Reminder scheduled: "ZenithCare vendor switch ack + HIPAA microtraining" will post at T-72 and T-24 before the ack deadline.
Lina (Manager): If someone refuses to update beneficiary info, does that block payroll?
Rae (People Ops): No immediate payroll impact but managers will be flagged in the compliance export and we'll follow up. For unresponsive folks, we'll put a hold on voluntary beneficiary changes until they complete the ack.
Rae (People Ops): Manager checklist: 1) bulk upload CSV (see header above), 2) confirm DocuSign e-sign invites sent, 3) ensure PHI-handling staff complete HIPAA microtraining. I'll produce a CSV of completions after the window.
Rae (People Ops): Export command I'll use: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/benefits/zenith_switch_1945.csv ./zenith_switch_1945.csv```
Ava (SWE): If someone misses live enrollment window, can they do a retro change?
Tom (HRBP): Changes after the window require an exception routed through Benefits with justification; those are granted case-by-case.
Rae (People Ops): Final note: I'll drop a short manager script and a paste-ready Slack reminder in 30m. Please DM me or tag Tom for policy questions. Thanks! :sparkles:
